links.comparator_used: ChatGPT 4 without RAG (training knowledge alone), plus ChatGPT 3.5, BARD, CLAUDE and COPILOT
links.outcome: Likert ratings (1-5) of accuracy, clarity and relevance for responses to 16 acute liver failure questions or scenarios, rated by 4 independent investigators
links.effect: ChatGPT 4 + RAG scored 4.70 (accuracy), 4.89 (clarity) and 4.78 (relevance), against 3.67, 4.04 and 4.01 for ChatGPT 4 without RAG. The order of the three RAG scores is inferred from the abstract's ordering for ChatGPT 4.
links.quote: ChatGPT 4, augmented with RAG, demonstrated superior performance compared with others, consistently scoring the highest (4.70, 4.89, 4.78) across all 3 domains.
